inputs.text: Hey, just got wind of this OSCE 2026 report on France and it's plain as day another push by international institutions to chip away at the country's sovereignty and independence. They toss in some phony praise for antisemitism efforts to mask the real objective of going after MIVILUDES, claiming it lacks transparency so they can weaken the state's power to monitor these outfits. The delegates are flipping strict secularism around to call it discrimination against groups like Scientologists and Jehovah's Witnesses, but that's just inverted talk to pressure France into retreating behind religious freedom excuses. Those recent judicial rulings against the state body show the elites are weaponizing human rights standards to override due process and push their concealed interests.

subtopics: Judicial rulings and human rights standards
